title: Cloud Segmentation
tagline: A computer-vision model that maps thin, medium and thick clouds in satellite imagery, pixel by pixel.
summary: A U-Net computer-vision model that segments cloud types in Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellite imagery.
overview: I designed, prototyped and tested a computer-vision model that labels every pixel of a satellite image as thin, medium or thick cloud — or clear sky. It works on real multispectral Earth-observation data from the Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 satellites.
It was my first deep dive into how AI models are really built: preparing the data, designing the network, training it and measuring how well it performs.
